and their own Spanish names (and the junk ones are gone)
no TM teaches Splash, Tackle, Growl or Pound any more and every TM is a different move
several TMs now teach the modern moves

at level 15 a Water Pokemon is offered Aqua Jet but not Scald or Aqua Tail
modern moves of other types are not offered (Charmander gets no Water move)
the moves added in earlier versions are in the table too (Gengar: Poison Jab; Dragonite: Dragon Claw; Tyranitar: Dark Pulse)
the 22 Tito Pokemon Centers map to 22 different landmarks
at the start 28 partners can be traded with (22 TITO cities and six NPCs)
a city whose trade is used is left out
an NPC whose trade is done is left out (Kyle)
all six NPCs done leaves only TITO
once TITO is beaten every one of his cities is available again
everything used leaves the list empty
Ulex can always be fought: no badge lock any more
even with every milestone flag set
and the "gana otra medalla" text is gone
